mapper.sql: id, project_id, target_type, target_id, target_ref, summary, vector_id, model_name, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_summary (project_id, target_type, target_id, target_ref, summary, vector_id, model_name, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetRef}, #{summary}, #{vectorId}, #{modelName}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE code_summary SET project_id = #{projectId}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_id = #{targetId}, target_ref = #{targetRef}, summary = #{summary}, vector_id = #{vectorId}, model_name = #{modelName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM code_summary WHERE vector_id = #{vectorId} LIMIT 1
